items.title: Record the 16 prompt filenames and template hashes
items.context: M0.1 requires an exact current prompt baseline from promptRegistryManifest or the current prompt registry source so later proof-or-stop-* migrations can compare hashes without relying on memory.
items.userSees: User sees "PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: roleCount=16 registry hashes verified" in node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs output.

happy.desc: The baseline JSON records exactly 16 prompt roles from promptRegistryManifest/readPromptRegistry with filename, relPath, bytes, templateHash, and registry materialHash.

edge.desc: The verifier fails when a prompt template is added, removed, renamed, or hash-changed without updating the baseline.

adversarial.desc: The verifier does not trust a hand-maintained role list alone; it recomputes the role list and material hash from the built prompt registry.

verificationEvidence.note: Current latest-main baseline records exactly 16 registry roles with source file, relPath, bytes, lines, templateHash, agent_prompt output hash, and registry material hash; normal verification passed.
Nine negative mutations prove registry material/template hash drift plus missing, extra, renamed, and declared-count role drift are rejected.
The drift harness mutates recomputed registry snapshots rather than trusting the authored matrix, and rejects role identity/count and template/hash tampering.

items.title: Capture agent_prompt output for every role as comparison artifacts
items.context: M0.2 requires current lattice agent_prompt --role output for all 16 roles so prompt body and routing changes in later milestones have a stable before snapshot.
items.userSees: User sees "PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: agent_prompt output hashes verified for 16 roles" in node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs output.

happy.desc: For every registry role, the verifier obtains lattice agent_prompt output and records/verifies output sha256, byte count, and line count against the baseline.

edge.desc: The verifier fails when agent_prompt output diverges from the registry-derived baseline for any role.

adversarial.desc: The verifier fails closed if agent_prompt omits a role, returns an unknown-role error for a registry role, or returns duplicate output ownership.

verificationEvidence.note: All 16 registry roles produced agent_prompt stdout matching the built template, with sha256, byte count, and line count locked in the baseline.
Focused negative mutations prove agent_prompt stdout sha256 and byte drift are rejected.
Focused negative mutations prove renamed/missing/extra role-output ownership and role-count/identity drift fail closed.

items.title: Produce a role-overlap matrix for all 16 prompts
items.context: M0.3 requires phase, allowed commands, direct file access, output artifact, status, and overlap category for every prompt so M1/M3 can split responsibilities without guessing.
items.userSees: User sees "PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: role matrix snapshot integrity verified for 16 roles" and "INFO proof-or-stop prompt baseline: all human-authored role-matrix semantics remain reviewer-audited" in node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs output.

happy.desc: The overlap matrix includes all 16 roles with phase, purpose, command surface, input, output artifact, current status, and overlap category.

edge.desc: The verifier fails if any baseline role is missing from the overlap matrix or if the matrix role count differs from the registry count.

adversarial.desc: The matrix explicitly marks legacy, retired, conditional, or overlapping responsibilities instead of hiding them under generic active labels.

verificationEvidence.note: All 16 matrix rows contain every required field; all human-authored semantics are explicitly reviewer-audited under the uniform Commands inclusion/exclusion contract.
Negative matrix mutations prove changed field, generated Markdown parity, removed role, role-count mismatch, and missing-row drift are rejected.
Matrix explicitly identifies active, conditional, optional, compatibility, legacy, fold-candidate, and retired-cli-only roles, with exact current/target replacement naming and overlap boundaries.

items.title: Add regression checks for legacy verification vocabulary in active prompts
items.context: M0.4 requires a mechanical check that active non-legacy prompts cannot use testIntent or TEST_CASE_REVIEW unless explicitly legacy-marked.
items.userSees: User sees "PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: legacy vocabulary findings classified" in node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs output.

happy.desc: The verifier scans every prompt for testIntent, TEST_CASE, and TEST_CASE_REVIEW vocabulary and records all baseline findings with role, line, term, and classification.

edge.desc: The verifier permits only explicitly baseline-classified legacy/deprecation/context mentions and fails on any new unclassified legacy verification vocabulary in active non-legacy prompts.

adversarial.desc: The verifier treats lowercase/camelCase/phase-name legacy variants as in scope so a prompt cannot bypass the guard through spelling differences.

verificationEvidence.note: Legacy scanner records current testIntent, TEST_CASE, and TEST_CASE_REVIEW occurrences with role status, classification, and explicit-context policy result.
An active role instruction `Set testIntent...` without old/legacy/deprecation context is rejected during collection/baseline refresh.
Active-role policy is applied after case-insensitive legacy regex matching that covers camelCase plus spaced, hyphenated, and underscored test-intent/test-case-review forms.

items.title: Add regression checks for direct story-file write instructions
items.context: M0.6 requires a mechanical check that prompts requiring direct writes under docs/story are flagged unless a CLI command is missing and the prompt is explicitly grandfathered.
items.userSees: User sees "PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: direct story-file findings classified" in node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs output.

happy.desc: The verifier scans every prompt for docs/story references and classifies each as policy reminder, read-only reference, direct read, direct write, or process-event evidence reference.

edge.desc: The verifier fails on any new direct docs/story write instruction that is not explicitly registered in the baseline with a grandfather/remediation classification.

adversarial.desc: The verifier distinguishes harmless reminders like do not directly read/write docs/story from actionable shell redirection or edit instructions that would bypass Lattice CLI state changes.

verificationEvidence.note: Current docs/story references are classified and the verifier confirms the direct story-write policy has exactly one explicit grandfathered current INIT write; every unapproved recognized or unclassified actionable write blocks collection and baseline refresh.

Twenty-three classifier probes cover mixed policy/write text, apply_patch headers, Edit/Write, tee, sed, redirection, cp/copy/mv/move/install/rsync, exact grandfathering, pure prohibitions, and unknown mutations; one scanner probe proves a backslash-continued cp destination is caught.

Baseline refresh now rejects both unknown actionable forms and recognized direct writes unless they exactly match the single explicit allow entry; role-wide grandfathering was removed and multiline scanner behavior is exercised.
